claim: An Enhanced palette fits a 4-bit sprite engine with Spectrum default colours when the map changes only entries no figure's cell colours use (PAL_FREE): unpainted figures keep the game's colours.
limit: As many new colours as unused entries (Altered Beast 4, Spellbound 5); the boot check compares the loaded palette with the map's, and recolour rewrites it.

evidence.text: Enhanced colours (2026-11-27): the map's palette may change only entries 1, 9, 12, 13 (no level-1 figure uses them), now skin, skin shade, brown and orange-gold; a figure the map does not paint keeps the game's colours exactly.
